title: Koi Wakhray Rog Nay Abid
body:
Koi wakhray rog nay Abid day peya turda Haye ratt ronda aay .
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Bazara’n wich Zahra Jaeyan day wain haya day ponda aay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ek saang tay chadar Zainab di ek saang tay sir Shabir da
Aay sadma wich bazara’n day Ali Abid nu tarpanda aay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aye arsh e ula day Haye wasday jado sham day sadar bazar aay
Kuj sharam kero aa muslamnao asi Aal e Nabi samjhanda aay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Sir naizeyan nay zakhmi kitay tay zakhmi payr nay rahwaa’n
Her morr tay sabar nu Abid day her shakhs reya azmanda aay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Turna majmay wich faajraa’n day paband e rasan phuphiyan da
Dil cheer geya beemar da is wastay khoon wahanda aay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Main putar Rasool e Khuda da haan Mera baba Najaf da shah aay
Ek qaidi sham day loka nu ro Sehar aay wayn sunranda aay..
